human_gate.rule: Federal submissions remain preparation-only until Robert verifies official portal status, authority, package contents, cybersecurity implications, cost, and final submission intent.

official_sources.label: SAM.gov entity registration
official_sources.lumen_gate: Robert verifies active registration, UEI/CAGE status, renewal date, entity roles, assertions, and representations directly in SAM.gov.
official_sources.protocol_fact: SAM.gov assigns the Unique Entity ID during entity registration and says registrations must be renewed every 365 days to stay active.

official_sources.label: SAM.gov entity registration checklist
official_sources.lumen_gate: Do not treat a local profile field as award eligibility; portal status must be checked before final submission.
official_sources.protocol_fact: The checklist says to allow at least ten business days after submitting a SAM registration for it to become active.

official_sources.label: Grants.gov applicant registration
official_sources.lumen_gate: Robert verifies profile, role, workspace, and application package state before any Grants.gov action.
official_sources.protocol_fact: Grants.gov says an organization profile uses the SAM.gov UEI and the EBiz POC assigns roles such as AOR and Workspace Manager.

official_sources.label: Grants.gov EBiz POC role authorization
official_sources.lumen_gate: AOR authority and signing responsibility remain human verified before final submit.
official_sources.protocol_fact: Grants.gov says the EBiz POC must authorize roles before a user can complete or submit application packages on behalf of the organization.

official_sources.label: Grants.gov Workspace roles
official_sources.lumen_gate: Workspace participation and AOR privileges must be checked opportunity by opportunity.
official_sources.protocol_fact: Grants.gov says Standard AOR can submit the final application and Workspace Manager is the minimum core role to create and start a workspace.

official_sources.label: SBIR/STTR eligibility tutorial
official_sources.lumen_gate: Ownership, affiliate, PI employment, for-profit status, and award-time eligibility stay human verified.
official_sources.protocol_fact: SBIR.gov states the small business must be primarily U.S. owned, generally at least 51% by U.S. citizens or permanent residents.

official_sources.label: SBIR/STTR eligibility FAQ
official_sources.lumen_gate: Local small-business posture is evidence for review, not final eligibility certification.
official_sources.protocol_fact: SBIR.gov says the awardee must qualify as a Small Business Concern under SBA SBIR/STTR rules.

official_sources.label: Defense SBIR/STTR funding opportunities
official_sources.lumen_gate: DSIP organization linkage, Firm PIN, topic forms, cost package, certifications, and submit button remain human controlled.
official_sources.protocol_fact: Defense SBIR/STTR says all DoW SBIR and STTR proposals must be submitted electronically through DSIP as described in the BAA or CSO.

official_sources.label: DARPA SBIR/STTR participation guide
official_sources.lumen_gate: DICE and other DARPA-package final submit stays blocked until Robert verifies the complete package and portal status.
official_sources.protocol_fact: DARPA says SBIR/STTR proposals are prepared and submitted through DSIP and are not considered submitted until Submit Proposal is clicked.

official_sources.label: DoW CIO CMMC program
official_sources.lumen_gate: No CMMC, SPRS, FCI, CUI, or enclave representation is made unless official evidence supports the exact claim.
official_sources.protocol_fact: DoW CIO says CMMC Phase 1 implementation runs November 10, 2025 through November 9, 2026 and focuses primarily on Level 1 and Level 2 self-assessments.

official_sources.label: DoW CIO About CMMC
official_sources.lumen_gate: Any FCI/CUI work requires a scoped environment, solicitation-specific requirements, and human-approved cybersecurity representation.
official_sources.protocol_fact: DoW CIO says CMMC addresses safeguarding requirements for FCI and CUI and requires specified levels as a condition of contract award when applicable.

protocol_rows.blocked_without_check: Do not submit federal contract or assistance material as eligible from local profile alone.
protocol_rows.required_human_check: Confirm active SAM.gov status, UEI, CAGE if assigned, renewal date, entity administrator, entity POCs, and current representations.

protocol_rows.blocked_without_check: Do not click final submission, certification, or signature-equivalent steps.
protocol_rows.required_human_check: Confirm Grants.gov account, organization profile, EBiz POC authorization, AOR role, workspace access, and package status.

protocol_rows.blocked_without_check: Do not represent an NSF invitation or full-proposal eligibility unless NSF issued it.
protocol_rows.required_human_check: Confirm NSF Project Pitch pending status, invitation status, Research.gov access, PI eligibility, and one-pending-pitch rule.

protocol_rows.blocked_without_check: Do not submit, certify, or claim DoW integration or procurement readiness.
protocol_rows.required_human_check: Confirm DSIP account, firm linkage, Firm PIN, topic forms, cost volume, reps, certifications, and final upload preview.

protocol_rows.blocked_without_check: Do not process protected federal information in general-purpose public tooling or ordinary sync folders.
protocol_rows.local_signal: proposal material currently treated as Unclassified and non-CUI unless official source marks otherwise
protocol_rows.required_human_check: Confirm whether the solicitation involves FCI, CUI, export controls, SPRS, CMMC level, enclave scope, or flow-down obligations.

protocol_rows.blocked_without_check: Do not expand patent-rights or exclusivity language in agency or investor materials.
protocol_rows.required_human_check: Confirm official patent status, support, new-matter risk, disclosure limits, and counsel-approved language.

protocol_rows.blocked_without_check: Do not let autonomous systems submit, sign, certify, transact, or move capital.
protocol_rows.required_human_check: Confirm paper/runtime state, external-action authority, and no capital-impacting step before any operational escalation.
